title: Keith's photo comparisons keep the pedestal findings
items: At 1808 Prairie, the comparisons against the 1888 Inland Architect plate and the 1965 slide show the loggia pedestals' findings again: plain panels in their border, a bordered south side still to build, and why the 1965 slide can't settle the stone's colour. A later change to the bow windows had dropped them from those two records.
